Adding Series

Add a TV show to your library and let NGMS handle the rest.

Adding a series

1

Series → Add Series

Type the show title in the search box. NGMS queries TMDB and returns matching results with poster art, year, and network.

2

Select the show and configure

Pick your Quality Profile, Root Folder, and Series Type (Standard, Daily, or Anime).

Monitor controls which episodes NGMS searches for:

  • All — every episode ever aired
  • Future — only episodes that haven't aired yet
  • Missing — episodes already aired that you don't have
  • None — add to library but don't search automatically
3

Add and search

Click Add Series. If you chose a monitor option that includes existing episodes, NGMS immediately queues a search for missing items. You can also click Search for Missing manually from the series detail page.

Series detail page

After adding, click the series poster to open its detail page. From here you can:

  • See all seasons and episodes with their file status (missing, grabbed, imported)
  • Force-search individual episodes or whole seasons
  • Change monitor status per episode or season
  • View grab and import history
  • Manually import files from the Import tab
  • Edit the quality profile, root folder, or rename settings

Series types explained

TypeWhen to useEpisode matching
Standard Most scripted TV (S01E01 format) SxxExx or season/episode number
Daily News, talk shows (aired by date) YYYY-MM-DD in release name
Anime Anime with absolute episode numbering Absolute episode number (e.g. 127)
✦
Existing files? If you already have the show on disk, add it first then use Series → Import (or the main Import page) to match existing files before NGMS starts searching for anything.
